system is allowed to stop; it is not allowed to forget.

    """Append ``entry`` to ``buffer``, raising at the cap instead of dropping."""

    if len(buffer) >= cap:
        raise RuntimeError(f"audit buffer at capacity ({cap}); cannot append without loss")
    buffer.append(entry)
    return {"kept": len(buffer), "dropped": 0}
